name: tables
description: Queryable tables: .ptable datasets that live on your drives like files, with csv/tsv/xlsx viewing, version history and full AI tooling.
help: Tables are .ptable datasets that live on your drives like files: they are indexed, searchable and keep a full version history.
CSV, TSV and XLSX files open in the tables viewer, where they can be sorted, filtered and converted to queryable .ptable datasets.
Ask the AI to build or maintain tables: it can create datasets, import your drive files and reshape columns — one answer leaves a single restorable history entry.
